Here's the thing nobody tells you about AI agents.

They don't fail loudly. They fail politely.

Ours registered a domain in staging because the task said 'make sure the name is available'. It was very helpful.

It's not about the tools. It's about the guardrails.

What guardrails are you putting around your agents?
